ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'in honoured pages' refer to in Shia Islamic theology?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the elevated status of the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt's preserved knowledge, often interpreted as the 'Infallible Book' (Kitab al-Maknun) kept with the Imams. It underscores the purity and divine protection of these sacred texts from corruption, reinforcing their role as the ultimate source of guidance for the faithful.
